title: Software Updates
upToDate: You are using the latest version.
unsafeSignature: Update signature verification failed. Installation blocked.
noticeTitle: A new TermVista version is available
noticeDescription: Version {{version}} is ready. Review it in Settings → About TermVista.
description: Check for stable updates. Downloads are not installed automatically. Pending edits, transfers, and operations are checked before installation.
desktopOnly: Check for updates in the TermVista desktop app.
noReleaseNotes: No release notes are available for this version.
downloadedNotInstalled: Download complete. The update is not installed. Active sessions and background tasks will be checked again before installation.
downloadedNotInstalledShort: Download complete. The update is not installed.
completeBeforeInstall: Complete the following tasks before installing the update.
sessionCountChanged: The number of active sessions changed. Review the installation impact again.
installedRestartRequired: The update was installed. Restart TermVista to use the new version.
installerTookOver: The system installer has taken over. Follow its instructions; the app may close and restart when installation completes.
installedRestarting: The update is installed. TermVista is restarting.
installRestartNotice: Installation restarts the client. The state of remote shell processes cannot be confirmed, and TermVista will not restore remote processes.
confirmInstallDescription: There are {{ssh}} SSH sessions and {{tunnels}} port forwards active. Installation interrupts the client terminal and tunnels. Remote commands may continue running on the server; TermVista will not restore remote processes.

errors.notFound: The update manifest has not been published (HTTP 404). Try again later or check GitHub Releases.
errors.forbidden: GitHub temporarily denied access to the update manifest (HTTP 403). Try again later.
errors.signature: Update signature verification failed. TermVista blocked installation. Do not bypass verification.
errors.network: Cannot reach the update service. Check your network and try again.
errors.unknown: The update operation failed. Check your network and system clock, then try again.

blockers.dirtyDocuments: {{count}} remote file(s) have unsaved changes. Save them or cancel the update.
blockers.activeTransfers: {{count}} SFTP transfer(s) are still active. Wait for them to finish or cancel them.
blockers.maintenanceTasks: Local or remote operations are in progress: {{labels}}.
blockers.savingSettings: App settings are being saved. Try installing again later.
blockers.pendingSsh: An SSH connection, authentication, or disconnect operation is still in progress.
blockers.changingTunnels: A port forward is starting or stopping. Try installing again later.
